title: Shopify removes pre_tax_price from REST order line items
summary: The pre_tax_price and pre_tax_price_set fields on order line items in the REST Admin API are removed. They were only populated for stores using the Avalara AvaTax 1.0 integration, deprecated in April 2025.
migrationNote: Read order line item pricing from the GraphQL Admin API instead of pre_tax_price.
